facts.text: The README says the library has been tested with the M32 and M24C models and should work with other CryoCon models
A CryoCon simulator is provided and is installed with the simulator extra
The hardware accepts a query only every 100 ms, and queries can be grouped in a single request
CryoCon binds the system properties to *IDN, SYSTEM:NAME, SYSTEM:HWR, SYSTEM:FWR, SYSTEM:LOCKOUT, SYSTEM:REMLED, SYSTEM:DISTC, SYSTEM:DATE and SYSTEM:TIME
to_date and to_time parse the SYSTEM:DATE and SYSTEM:TIME replies into datetime.date and datetime.time
channel_member builds the ':INPUT <id>:<name>' command, and Channel binds NAM, TEMP, UNIT, MIN, MAX, VARI, SLOP, OFFS and ALAR to it
A channel's unit is one of K, C, F or S
to_float returns None for the fault '-------', out-of-range '.......' and 'N/A' replies
to_float_unit drops the last character of a set point reply (its unit character)
Loop.output_power reads OUTP and is a percentage
